items.title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
items.summary: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EUs distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.

items.title: BTC price gains 12% from $55K: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.summary: Nasdaq-100 futures rose 3.1% before Mondays open, while Wednesdays US inflation report could shape expectations for a December rate hike.

items.title: MoldyRoost ads can steal crypto wallet recovery phrases from iPhones
items.summary: The campaign used at least 480 ad domains to target users in more than 47 countries and could infect a vulnerable iPhone with a single tap.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.8B in third-largest weekly outflow
items.summary: Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $4.14 billion in November through Friday, nearing Junes $4.51 billion total.

items.title: Heres what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Trump renews call for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
items.summary: In a Truth Social post on Monday, Trump said rehiring Jensen Huang would benefit both Nvidia and the US.

items.title: Czech Authorities Charge 15 Over $12M Unlicensed Crypto Casino
items.summary: Investigators say "decentralized" casino BETFIN was run centrally, inflated its player numbers with bots and made $12 million illegally.

items.title: Solana Meme Coin for Fiona the Hippo Raises $100K for Cincinnati Zoo Charity
items.summary: A meme coin honoring the Cincinnati Zoo's late pygmy hippo has sent its creator rewards to the zoo's nonprofit.

items.title: Bitcoin Rebounds to $61K After Weekend Plunge to Two-Year Low
items.summary: Bitcoin swung by more than $6,000 over the weekend as tech stocks slid and spot ETFs logged their biggest daily outflow since June.

items.title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in 'Impossible' Game
items.summary: Googles Willow quantum processor beat the classical ceiling in a four-qubit coordination game, revealing a promising hardware test rather than commercial quantum computing.

items.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
items.summary: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

items.title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
items.summary: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platformseven faking SEC certificates and filingsto defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

items.title: The dots arent done, Michael Saylor says as Strategy buys another 457 BTC for $30 million
items.summary: Strategy's latest acquisitions came during a week that saw bitcoin drop to its lowest level in over two years.

items.title: Cross River Bank launches first bitcoin-backed loans with LendingUSA, offering up to $250,000
items.summary: LendingUSA and Cross River launch bitcoin-secured loans of $10,000 to $250,000 with 30%, 50% or 70% LTV, so borrowers can keep their BTC.

items.title: Visa launches experimental AI agent wallet for eligible US users to earn OUSD from paid tasks
items.summary: Visa is extending its agent verification infrastructure into paid work, allowing AI agents to earn OUSD via participating task marketplaces.

items.title: South Korea to publish draft of comprehensive crypto legal framework this week
items.summary: The draft is expected to include a licensing regime for crypto businesses and a bank-centered issuance system for local stablecoins.

items.title: Singapores OCBC, StraitsX launch pilot for cross-border business stablecoin payments
items.summary: The setup uses StraitsX's infrastructure for onchain collection and compliance, while OCBC handles the fiat off-ramp.

items.title: Ark buys $146 million in Anthropic shares last week, trims Ethereum and Solana Staking ETF holdings
items.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest has bought 1.64 million shares in Anthropic, worth $145.9 million, since its Thursday IPO.
